product_overview: Wajbati is an online marketplace where customers discover home-cooked meals from independent chefs, browse menus, and place food orders. Chefs use a dedicated dashboard to manage kitchen capacity and track order fulfillment, while administrators can view the platform overview.
core_goals: Discover meals and chefs through browsing, search, and category filtering
View detailed meal and chef information before ordering
Add meals to a cart, adjust quantities, and proceed to checkout
Register, log in, and manage a customer account
Track placed orders from the customer order history
Manage kitchen orders and capacity from the chef dashboard

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Users can register a new customer account or sign in with email/phone and password to access protected areas of the app.
user_flows: Navigate to /register -> Enter name, email or phone, and password confirmation -> Submit the registration form -> See the new account created
Navigate to /login -> Enter email or phone -> Enter password -> Submit the login form -> See the authenticated session start
Navigate to /login -> Enter invalid credentials -> Submit the login form -> See inline validation feedback

features.name: Meal Discovery and Filtering
features.description: Visitors can browse the meal catalog, search by keyword, filter by category, and open a meal to inspect its details.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Search for a meal or kitchen keyword -> See matching meals on the home page
Navigate to /meals -> Search for a meal keyword -> See the catalog narrow to relevant results
Navigate to /meals -> Choose a category filter -> See meals update to that category
Navigate to /meals -> Select a meal card -> Open the meal details page
Navigate to /meals/{id} -> View ingredients, dietary information, preparation time, and chef details

features.name: Chef Directory and Profiles
features.description: Visitors can browse a directory of chefs and open an individual chef profile to see the kitchen bio and meals prepared by that chef.
user_flows: Navigate to /chefs -> Browse the list of chefs -> Select a chef profile -> Open the chef detail page
Navigate to /chefs -> Search or scan the directory -> Compare chef profiles and meal offerings
Navigate to /chefs/{id} -> View the chef bio and meal list -> Choose a meal to continue browsing

features.name: Add to Cart and Cart Management
features.description: Users can add meals to a temporary cart, review items grouped by kitchen, and change quantities or remove items before checkout.
user_flows: Navigate to /meals/{id} -> Add the meal to the cart -> See a success confirmation
Navigate to /cart -> Review items grouped by chef -> Increase or decrease an item quantity -> See the cart totals update
Navigate to /cart -> Remove an item from the cart -> See the item disappear from the cart
Navigate to /cart -> View an empty cart -> See the empty-state message and browse-meals call to action

features.name: Checkout and Order History
features.description: Registered customers can confirm an order from their cart, choose delivery and payment details, and then review the order in their history.
user_flows: Navigate to /cart -> Proceed to checkout -> Select a delivery address and payment method -> Submit the order -> See the order placed with pending status
Navigate to /orders -> Review the order history list -> Open an order -> See order status tracking and receipt details
Navigate to /orders -> View previously placed orders -> Compare current statuses across orders

features.name: Customer Profile Management
features.description: Authenticated customers can open their profile area to manage personal information and delivery addresses.
user_flows: Navigate to /profile -> View saved profile information -> Update personal details or address information -> Save the changes

features.name: Chef Dashboard
features.description: Chefs can review daily order activity, manage kitchen capacity, and update order fulfillment status from their dashboard.
user_flows: Navigate to /chef/dashboard -> View daily order metrics -> Review current kitchen status and order volume
Navigate to /chef/dashboard -> Update kitchen capacity -> Save the new capacity -> See the dashboard reflect the change
Navigate to /chef/dashboard -> Open an incoming order -> Change the order status -> See the updated fulfillment state

features.name: Admin Dashboard
features.description: Administrators can access the platform overview dashboard to monitor the system at a high level.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> View the administrative overview dashboard -> Review platform metrics and summaries

routes.description: Home page with search bar, meal categories, featured chefs and meals
Meal catalog with search, category filtering, and sorting
Detailed meal view with ingredients, nutritional info, chef info, and add to cart
Directory of independent chefs and home kitchens
Chef profile page with kitchen bio and list of meals
Shopping cart page showing items grouped by chef, delivery fee, and checkout button
User authentication login form with email/phone and password
User registration form for new customers
Customer orders history and tracking list
Single order details view with status tracking and receipt
Customer saved favorite meals and chefs
Chef management portal with order metrics and kitchen status
Development helper route for switching test roles (customer, chef, admin)
